thoughts: I should bake some spiced seed biscuits later today.
The way the frost catches the cobblestones is pure magic.
Pip whispered that he wants a tiny wool hat.
I wonder who will visit the gallery this afternoon.
My paws feel wonderfully nimble after that sleep.
Green paint always reminds me of spring moss hiding under snow.
The town square looks so peaceful before everyone wakes up.
I love the sound of my claws clicking on the workshop floor.
